items.text: ​Hi Runners,

Please note that the update will be coming to Nintendo Switch 2 at a later date.

“5.7.2. Custom Brushes” section was added. Now you can add your own custom brushes for Distributions (Particularly, the guide contains instructions for adding custom brushes based on existing plant models. Brushes based on custom plant models are not described yet, since adding custom plants is а work in progress and has known issues)
“5.15.1.3.1. Setting up a Repairable (Upgradeable) Garage” section was modified: we added Step 3 -- required option for Terrain that should be enabled in case of the Upgradeable Garage setup
“5.15.7.3. Custom Prices for Trucks and Upgrades” section was modified: we added 1 Warning and 2 Tips on custom prices of trucks
“5.16.3.1. Adding Smoke” section was added: we added info on adding smoke to the map using the Model Building Settings pipeline

“Quick Mod Creation Guide: Adding Trucks” guide was also updated and refactored, particularly its part about uploading of the mod. You can find its fresh version (v1.5) in the “Quick Guide - Adding Trucks” subfolder of the google drive with all official guides (https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1m1smAee_OXWBIySJFPf0J0CteDHJrzg2)
Several broken links within the PDF of the Guide were fixed

(!!!) Dear mod creators, the fix to the problem in the mod editor, that we warned you about, will not be in the next patch, we will continue to work on fixing the issue. But for now here is the guidance on how to avoid the issue: add all the new rivers and overlays to groups; before editing the old ones - transfer them to groups. We strongly recommend you to follow the guidance. Apologies for the inconvenience.
